label: bug
finding: Opening the dossier view in test/ui_audit.mjs took 5,501,793 ms (92 min) at 1920x1080 on SwiftShader
evidence_v1_3: v1.4 beta audit log; other views 15-45 s; a re-run of the same sequence took 29 s, so the stall depends on load: the page re-rendered the whole globe on every animation frame (about 1 fps after the fly-in) and starved the capture under CPU contention
fix_v1_4: Render on demand (Cesium requestRenderMode plus app render requests on state change and input; 2.5 s heartbeat on software WebGL): an idle globe draws about 6 frames in 10 s; test/perf.mjs and the ui_audit gate fail a view over its budget, and a 300 s hard limit stops a hang
